text:
elaine: Quick sync — want to finalize the synchronous check-in cadence and qualifier trigger for the next DP wave. Proposal below, please react with :thumbsup: / :eyes: or reply if a hard no.

sami: quick thought — keep it light for design partners, they already get weekly product emails. Maybe 30m focused sessions + async notes.

juan: engineering ask — what level of commitment are we expecting for bug turnaround? We should set an SLA so we can staff oncall devs for DP hours.

elaine: good call. Proposed coordination model: 
- Cadence: 30m weekly syncs for first 6 weeks after onboarding, then 45m monthly show-and-tell for the pilot lifetime.
- Qualifier trigger to join synchronous track: must complete the prep checklist + run a 10-minute integration smoke test in staging.
- No-show policy: 2 misses -> convert to asynchronous only, but we still keep them in monitoring.
- Engineering SLA: triage within 24h, P1 response within 48h during active pilot.

marie: on success metrics: recommend we track 3 signals: activation (3 meaningful calls in 7 days), qualitative feedback score (post-sync survey avg >= 4/5), and regression rate (<= 2 regressions/week per DP).

juan: 48h P1 response seems tight given other squads. Can we scope P1 to "blocking for DP usage" only and use a dev-rotation (2 engineers) for the 6-week intensive phase?

elaine: yes, define P1 = blocks DP from progressing or a data loss issue. We'll propose a temporary dev-rotation for the pilot weeks and document coverage in the onboarding sheet.

sami: onboarding kit items we need for synchronous track: 1) Integration checklist (env vars, auth, model pins), 2) Quickstart snippet, 3) A template agenda for 30m syncs. I'll draft agenda.

elaine: agenda draft (30m): 
- 0-5m: status + ask
- 5-15m: live usage / demo
- 15-25m: blockers + engineering deep-dive
- 25-30m: quick action items + next steps

marie: survey template (post-sync): 
"How useful was this sync? (1-5) | Any regressions observed? (yes/no) | Top 1 request"
Include an optional field for logs or sample prompts.

elaine: adding a short automated probe we can run after each sync to capture a 1-line SLA snapshot. ops-bot, can we add a repo label and a short workflow to auto-create an issue when a DP flags a regression?

ops-bot: sure — `dp-regression` label created in the product repo. Quick workflow snippet: ```yaml
on: issues
jobs:
  notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: tag dp regression
        if: contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'dp-regression')
        run: echo "DP regression flagged — paging rotation"
```

juan: that helps. also let's add a single Slack thread per DP that auto-populates with the weekly meeting notes so we have an audit trail.

elaine: agreed — ops will create a thread template and invite DP core contacts + eng buddy. I'll update the DP handbook with the final SLA and cadence by EOD tomorrow.

sami: fine by me. I'll draft the agenda + quickstart and post in #product for review. :thumbsup:

marie: I'll own the post-sync survey collection and dashboarding (weekly rollup).

elaine: next actions: 
- sami -> agenda + onboarding kit (due in 48h)
- juan -> confirm rotation names and coverage model (48h)
- marie -> survey payload + dashboard spec (72h)
- ops-bot -> create dp thread template + dp-regression workflow (24h)

elaine: wrapping up — if anyone has a hard objection to the SLA/cadence call it out here, otherwise i'll surface this to the pilot ops doc and start scheduling slots. :wave:
